prerequisites: Good skills in basics of differential and integral calculus and matrix algebra, such as in courses MS-A000X Matrix algebra, MS-A02XX Differential and integral calculus 2, or equivalent knowledge.

learning_outcomes.text: The student should learn the basic principles of signal and system analysis.
The student should know the most common signal transforms.
The student should understand the frequency domain representation of the signal and learn to use for signal analysis.
After the course the student should master filtering of deterministic signals with linear lowpass and bandpass filters.
The student should know the principles of analog to digital transform and the utilized mapping parameters.

syllabus_topics: Linear systems and their signal analysis
